package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"reflect"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
)

const maximumHybridApplicationResponseBytes = 64 << 10

var _ domainservice.HybridStudentApplicationService = Client{}

func (client Client) ApplyHybridConsequence(ctx context.Context, c domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridApplicationReceipt, error) {
	var result domain.HybridApplicationReceipt
	if domain.ValidateHybridConsequence(c) != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.WriteToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	raw, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil || len(raw) > domain.MaximumHybridSnapshotRequestBytes {
		return result, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	endpoint := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/v1/students/" + url.PathEscape(c.StudentID) + "/learning-paths/" + url.PathEscape(c.LearningPathID) + "/hybrid-consequences"
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(raw))
	if err != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.WriteToken)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	response, err := client.HTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	if response.StatusCode >= 500 {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	contentType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(response.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || contentType != "application/json" {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	raw, err = io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, maximumHybridApplicationResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	if len(raw) > maximumHybridApplicationResponseBytes || validateHybridJSONEnvelope(raw) != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		var envelope struct {
			Error string `json:"error"`
		}
		if decodeHybridApplicationJSON(raw, &envelope) != nil {
			return result, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		switch {
		case response.StatusCode == 409 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_STALE":
			return result, domain.ErrHybridApplicationStale
		case response.StatusCode == 409 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_INTENT_REQUIRED":
			return result, domain.ErrHybridApplicationIntentRequired
		case response.StatusCode == 409 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_UNSAFE":
			return result, domain.ErrHybridApplicationUnsafe
		case response.StatusCode == 409 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_CONFLICT":
			return result, domain.ErrConflict
		case response.StatusCode == 422 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_UNSUPPORTED":
			return result, domain.ErrHybridApplicationUnsupported
		case response.StatusCode == 422 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_INVALID":
			return result, domain.ErrValidation
		case response.StatusCode == 404 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_NOT_FOUND":
			return result, domain.ErrNotFound
		case response.StatusCode == 403 && envelope.Error == "HYBRID_FORBIDDEN":
			return result, domain.ErrForbidden
		default:
			return result, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
	}
	if decodeHybridApplicationJSON(raw, &result) != nil || domain.ValidateHybridApplicationReceipt(result, c) != nil {
		return domain.HybridApplicationReceipt{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return result, nil
}

func decodeHybridApplicationJSON(raw []byte, result any) error {
	if validateHybridJSONShape(raw, reflect.TypeOf(result).Elem(), "") != nil {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(result) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		return domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return nil
}
